report.heading: Mood & wellness report
report.adherenceNote: Doses taken as a share of the journalled days on which each medication was being tracked. A day the medication was not marked counts as not taken. Days with no journal entry are not counted either way.
report.moodLegend: Bars: 1-2 red, 3-4 orange, 5-6 yellow, 7-8 green, 9-10 blue. Line: 7-day average. Triangle: a dose change. A gap is a day without an entry.
report.effects: Mood on days with and without
report.effectsNote: Averages of logged days. A difference is an observation, not a cause.

mood.heading: Mood
mood.legend: Line: 7-day average. Triangle: a dose change.
